overall_status: PARTIAL_MATCH: the eight-case rebuilt-Cover projection (endpoint pairs, flags, dirty lifecycle, descendant/slot identity, op orders) byte-matches the locked oracle, and the production self-lock topology (MULTIEQUAL slot 2 holding the rebuilt root) is covered; order-only CoverBlock residuals (addRefPoint old-stop MULTIEQUAL-tip discrimination, INDIRECT getOpFromConst target order), production FlowBlock index assignment, and the full ActionMergeType caller closure remain outside this atomic change

oracle.signature: void Varnode::updateCover(void) const; void Cover::rebuild(const Varnode *vn); void Cover::addRefPoint(const PcodeOp *ref,const Varnode *vn)

architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of locked Varnode::updateCover -> Cover::rebuild on synthetic def-use/CFG graphs built through production Funcdata APIs (newOp/opSetInput/newUniqueOut/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/addEdge/setInputVarnode/calcCover); no Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata; blocks receive deterministic creation-order FlowBlock indices as a precondition because production index assignment (BlockGraph::findSpanningTree reverse post-order) is a separate BLOCK-module dependency; ops receive BlockBasic::insert midpoint SeqNum orders via opInsertEnd
analysis_options.observation: Per case: coverdirty before/after with updateCover invoked twice for idempotence, hasCover, Cover-object presence, input/written/implied flags, defining op SeqNum order, descendant list order including repeat-slot double entries, exact-identity slot list for every descendant, every named op's order, and the complete Cover as ascending per-block index:start-end endpoint pairs in the uindex domain; endpoints print b (begin/input sentinel), e (end sentinel), or the decimal order
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, membership, or endpoint normalization; both sides print the same uindex-domain projection of the same observation fields

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: input_root: input Varnode read by one op in the successor block; def-point sentinel, backward fill into block 0, and b-e endpoints
phi_predecessor_fill: input Varnode at MULTIEQUAL slot 1 recurses into the second predecessor, exercising the addRefRecurse empty-branch setAll fill
defined_linear: written Varnode with same-block reader plus branch-block reader; midpoint op orders, contain check, and setEnd(1) tail extension

slot2_selfref_double: 3-input MULTIEQUAL whose slots 1 and 2 are the rebuilt root itself (production self-lock topology) plus a two-slot INT_XOR reader; every exact-identity slot recurses its predecessor
slot2_single: 3-input MULTIEQUAL with the root only at slot 2, isolating single-slot self-reference recursion from the double-slot read
implied_chain: reader whose output is implied pushes that output onto the rebuild worklist so ITS readers extend the cover
dirty_flag_cycle: calcCover sets coverdirty, updateCover clears it, and a second updateCover is an idempotent no-op
no_cover_object: hasCover varnode with the dirty bit set but no Cover object; updateCover clears the bit without allocating a Cover

observation_schema.format: Nine fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus eight case records
observation_schema.state: coverdirty before/after, hasCover, cover-object presence, input/written/implied, def order
observation_schema.graph: descendant list order with repeat-slot entries, exact-identity slot list, per-op SeqNum orders
observation_schema.cover: ascending block-index start-end endpoint pairs in the uindex domain (b/e sentinels or decimal order)

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-cover-rebuild-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of Varnode::cover and the Cover block map through #define private public in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/cover.rs, src/varnode.rs, and src/merge.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again

coverage.input_varnode_def_point: MATCH: addDefPoint input branch stores the uindex-domain value of the (PcodeOp*)2 sentinel (begin/begin), and addRefRecurse extends block 0's tail to the end sentinel
coverage.phi_predecessor_setall_fill: MATCH: MULTIEQUAL slot recursion reaches an uncovered predecessor whose addRefRecurse empty branch fills it with setAll and recurses its own predecessors
coverage.defined_linear_readers: MATCH: same-block reader hits the contain/extend path, branch reader seeds a fresh block, and the backward recursion extends the defining block's tail
coverage.multiequal_slot2_self_reference_double_s: MATCH: the rebuilt root appears as MULTIEQUAL inputs 1 and 2 and as both INT_XOR inputs; every exact-identity slot recurses its matching predecessor while unrelated slots do not
coverage.multiequal_slot2_single: MATCH: single slot-2 self-reference recursion differs observably from the double-slot case in the second predecessor's endpoint
coverage.implied_output_worklist_extension: MATCH: an implied op output is pushed onto the rebuild worklist and its reader extends the cover exactly like a direct reader
coverage.coverdirty_lifecycle_and_idempotence: MATCH: calcCover sets coverdirty, updateCover clears it after rebuilding, and a second updateCover neither rebuilds nor changes state
coverage.no_cover_object_dirty_clear: MATCH: hasCover varnode with the dirty bit but no Cover object clears the bit without allocating a Cover
coverage.seqnum_midpoint_order_model: MATCH for the exercised BlockBasic::insert paths (first-op midpoint from order 2 and append midpoint); the dense setOrder renumber path is covered by OP-INSERT-0001
coverage.block_index_assignment: UNTESTED: production BlockGraph::findSpanningTree reverse-post-order index assignment is not exercised; the fixture assigns deterministic creation-order indices as a precondition (registered as BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001)
coverage.multiequal_tip_old_stop: MISMATCH: the order-only CoverBlock cannot recover addRefPoint's old-stop MULTIEQUAL-tip discrimination; Rugra conservatively falls through to recursion for MULTIEQUAL refs
coverage.indirect_target_order: MISMATCH: CoverBlock::get_u_index falls back to the INDIRECT op's own SeqNum order instead of resolving the getOpFromConst target order
coverage.merge_update_high_cover_caller: PARTIAL: update_high_cover now calls Varnode::update_cover_locked per instance so the root write lock is never re-entered; the full ActionMergeType caller closure and post-cleanup action order remain PIPE-MERGETYPE-ORDER-0001
coverage.start_stop_pointer_identity: MISMATCH: Rugra stores uindex-domain orders rather than PcodeOp* pointer values; endpoint classification (begin/end/order) is compared instead of raw pointers
coverage.multiequal_reader_of_implied_intermediat: UNTESTED: no fixture case drives a MULTIEQUAL reader of an implied intermediate output, so the root-vs-current identity discrimination of that sub-branch is source-verified (cover.cc:490/606) but not fixture-observed; registered for a follow-up fixture case
